title: echo server crashed twice on Slack Sent-before-connected fatal
description: During the 2026-05-19 v1.0 portability autonomous session, the echo server died twice with: [FATAL] Uncaught exception — closing databases before crash: Sent before connected. The Slack adapter throws when sending on a socket that has not completed its handshake (visible in logs/server.log: rapid Slack disconnect/reconnect immediately precedes the fatal). Supervisor restarts the server, but during the window /coherence /capabilities /view /telegram-reply and tunnel renders all 503/timeout. The lifeline (pid 4130) keeps relaying — that fallback works. Repro signal: tail logs/server.log for Slack Socket Mode connected then Disconnected: reconnect cycles, then a Sent before connected crash within seconds. Affects any agent with the Slack adapter enabled. Fix shape: guard SlackAdapter.send on connection state (queue or no-op rather than throw); larger design bug is that an uncaught exception in one adapter takes down the whole server — add a top-level adapter-error catch + degradation event so a single adapter cannot kill the host.
